verdict: Organic engagement softening; paid channels remain fully inactive this period.
narrative: No paid ads ran across Meta or Google in the last 28 days, so your Google Business Profile was the sole source of new engagement — delivering 60 total actions including 36 direction requests, 23 website clicks, and 1 call. Over the most recent three days (Aug 14–16), however, GBP actions dropped sharply compared to the three days prior, and site sessions followed the same downward trend, confirming the softening is real. With only 1 call generated from 60 profile actions this period, we're reviewing the profile content and landing experience to close that gap. Expect a clearer picture next week as those adjustments take effect.

call received from 60 profile actions, a conversion rate we are actively working to improve
website sessions recorded in the last 28 days, driven almost entirely by organic profile traffic

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement dropped roughly 90% over the last three days compared to the three days before — and site sessions fell 68% in the same window, confirming the dip is not a data artifact.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing the Business Profile content and the landing experience this week to strengthen both visibility and the prompt to call.
